intended_object: For linearly independent roots α = root i and β = root j of a crystallographic root pairing, the index of the bottom root β − qα of the α-string (α-chain) through β, where q is the largest n with β − nα a root. Inferred from the docstring and the module on root chains.
explanation: `chainBotCoeff i j` is q, the largest n such that β − n•α is a root. Under linear independence, the lemma `root_sub_nsmul_mem_range_iff_le_chainBotCoeff` with n = q (using `le_refl`) shows that β − q•α lies in the range of `P.root`. The definition then takes the witness index with `choose`. In a root pairing `P.root` is an embedding, so that index is unique and the choice is harmless. When α and β are linearly dependent the definition returns the junk value j, which the docstring states. This is the standard bottom of the α-string through β, packaged as an index in the setting of the library's root pairings. It is not a re-implementation of a more general Mathlib construction.
